collection.description: A child who notices tiny insect patterns struggles when friends change a game's rules without warning.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A child notices tiny insect patterns but struggles when friends change the rules of a game without warning.

choices.label: Invite the child to show their observations

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The game becomes easier for several children.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: Some friends become interested; others politely choose another game.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The child enjoys watching beetles with a patient friend.
